dialogues.speaker: Caua
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's a lot of vegetables. You're not looking for me to deliver them, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Tamal
dialogues.text: That's right! What do you say, Caua, these are some quality vegetables, right?

dialogues.speaker: Caua
dialogues.text: The veggie best... but my expertise lies more in delivering letters, transporting vegetables really isn't part of my job description...

dialogues.speaker: Caua
dialogues.text: *sigh* What am I saying? I end up delivering these things every time I come here anyway... Fine, load them onto my saurian friend over there and leave the rest to us.

dialogues.speaker: Tamal
dialogues.text: Haha, that's the Caua I know, reliable as always! Thanks again for your help!
